bibl.title: Posidippo, Ep. 52 Austin-Bastianini (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII 309, col. VIII 25-30): In morte di Timone o di Aste?
bibl.seg: Giuseppe Russo, Posidippo, Ep. 52 Austin-Bastianini (P. Mil. Vogl. VIII 309, col. VIII 25-30): In morte di Timone o di Aste?
bibl.note: P. Mil. Vogl. VIII, 309 (= MP3 1435.01; LDAB 3852), col. viii, 25-30. - An emendation and new supplements allow reading the epitymbion as commemorating eleven-year-old Aste, rather than his father Timon.
